summary: 表示「此时此刻正在做」的动作：be (am/is/are) + 动词-ing。

rules.title: 结构：be 动词 + 动词-ing（现在分词）
rules.detail: be 动词随主语变化（I am / he is / they are），动词一律加 ing。看now、Look!、Listen! 这些词，就优先考虑现在进行时。

examples.en: Look! The children are playing games.
I am doing my homework now.

rules.title: 动词-ing 的构成规则
rules.detail: 一般直接加 ing（read → reading）；以不发音的 e 结尾去 e 加 ing（write → writing，make → making）；重读闭音节双写末尾辅音再加 ing（run → running，swim → swimming，sit → sitting）。

examples.en: She is making a cake in the kitchen.
The boys are swimming in the river.

rules.title: 否定句与疑问句
rules.detail: 在 be 动词后加 not 构成否定；把 be 动词提前构成疑问句。不需要借助 do/does！

examples.en: He isn't reading a book; he is watching TV.
examples.zh: 他没在看书，他在看电视。

examples.en: Are you listening to me? — Yes, I am.

pitfalls: 漏掉 be 动词：❌ I reading a book. → ✓ I am reading a book.
双写错误：❌ He is runing. → ✓ He is running.
去 e 错误：❌ She is writeing. → ✓ She is writing.

questions.stem: Listen! Someone ___ in the next room.
questions.explain: Listen! 提示动作正在发生；someone 是单数，用 is singing。

questions.stem: — What are you doing now? — I ___ my room.
questions.explain: 问句是现在进行时，回答用 am cleaning。注意不能只答 cleaning，必须带 be 动词。

questions.stem: The students ___ ___ basketball on the playground now. (选择正确的动词形式)
questions.explain: students 复数用 are；now 提示进行时，play 加 ing。

questions.stem: It's seven o'clock. Mr. Wang ___ breakfast with his family.
questions.explain: 具体时刻点 + 正在进行的动作，用现在进行时 is having。

questions.stem: Look! The girl ___ (run) on the playground.
questions.explain: run 是重读闭音节，双写 n 加 ing：running。

questions.stem: They ___ (not do) their homework at the moment.
questions.explain: 现在进行时否定：are + not + doing。

questions.stem: — Where is Tom? — He ___ (write) a letter in his room.
questions.explain: write 以不发音 e 结尾，去 e 加 ing：writing。

questions.stem: The children is flying kites in the park now.
questions.explain: The children 是复数，be 动词要用 are。

questions.stem: 她现在正在图书馆看书。（翻译整句）
answer: she is reading books in the library now.
she is reading a book in the library now.
questions.explain: 「正在看」用 is reading；books 或 a book 均可。

questions.stem: 听！他们在教室里唱歌。（翻译整句）
answer: listen! they are singing in the classroom.
questions.explain: Listen! 是现在进行时的典型标志；they 对应 are singing。
